  Terms checked:     22

## Notes on findings
- reconcile (both files) MAJOR cleavage_agent_incomplete [missing: Lys-C]: FALSE POSITIVE for these SILAC files. The Lys-C + trypsin digest in the PRIDE sample protocol is the WCL (TMT) workflow ("digestion at room temperature for 3 h with LysC ... Trypsin (Pierce) was then added"). The SILAC PMP protocol digests with trypsin only ("Captured protein was digested on-bead with trypsin in 100 mM HEPES pH 8.5 for 3 h", PRIDE protocol and paper STAR Methods), and the SILAC IP samples were in-gel digested (ProGest) and searched as "Trypsin/P digestion" (paper). Neither SILAC arm mentions Lys-C. reconcile exit code 0.
- parse_sdrf validate-sdrf IP: WARNING "fetal stage" not found in efo: HsapDv:0000037 "fetal stage" (OLS, not obsolete) is the Cellosaurus "AG Fetus" translation used by campaign precedent PXD004666; a warning, exit 0.
- parse_sdrf convert-openms exit 1 (both files): "Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available". No MaxQuant parameters (mqpar.xml / parameters.txt / summary.txt) were deposited for the combined SILAC search and the paper states no tolerances, so the tolerances are honestly not available (same outcome as campaign precedents PXD014368, PXD006676, PXD024103).
- OLS HTTP 500 retries in validate-sdrf were transient; both runs finished with exit 0 ("Everything seems to be fine" / "only warnings").
